summary: A London immigration firm appears to lose clients to a free builder address, a keyword heavy menu and no enquiry form.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Weebly address.
findings.cost: Clients choosing an immigration adviser judge credibility first, and a free builder address looks temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain and a firm email.

findings.problem: The menu appears to repeat the same keywords, such as Immigration Law Solicitors, Immigration Solicitors and Immigration Applications.
findings.cost: Repeated keywords read like spam and do not tell a client what happens next.
findings.fix: A clear menu with real service pages.

findings.problem: The page appears to say contact us on line, but I did not see an enquiry form.
findings.cost: A client in a hurry will not copy an email address, so they contact another firm.
findings.fix: A short enquiry form on the page.

findings.problem: The firm name appears with a stray space, I mmigration, and no WhatsApp appears.
findings.cost: Typos in the firm's own name weaken trust, and many clients prefer to message first.
findings.fix: A corrected name and a one tap WhatsApp button.
